content: Welcome to WikiDoc. We appreciate your visit to WikiDoc, the first and largest wiki platform dedicated exclusively to medicine. WikiDoc was developed in alignment with the principles of Internet 2.0 and serves as an online community where individuals can actively contribute to and edit the world's most extensive free, continuously updated medical textbook. This collaborative process is referred to as Co-creation. All contributions are carefully reviewed and monitored by medical professionals who serve as Editors-In-Chief. To participate, you only need basic knowledge of how to use a word processor. Hundreds of contributors are actively involved in enhancing WikiDoc, and you can view their most recent updates and edits by navigating to the Recent Changes page. Anyone is welcome to explore WikiDoc by entering a specific topic of interest into the search box or by selecting one of the available categories. However, if you wish to contribute to or edit the content and receive proper acknowledgment for your contributions, you will need to create a username.
